facts: Public QuickScanWorkStore AST enumeration has no immediate release/unclaim method for an unexpired active lease.
cancel_pending rejects leased work; recover_expired returns unchanged status before actual expiry.
resolve_known_response requires an original known native response, so it is not applicable to zero model attempts.
restore_finalization_handle requires an original successful response and restores only that original lease; it cannot restore unsent work.

reconcile_budget_attempt confirmed_not_sent requires cost zero, records an immutable terminal and changes original budget counters in its original transaction; it does not modify the immutable search operation/receipt.
Original external journal accounted() accepts a settled budget; _assert_no_unknown_scope also requires a non-unknown terminal when no prepaid proof exists.
External cache key includes the full plan and search-policy SHA. A separately recorded query_id revision changes operation/cache identity without deleting the prior unknown history.
Composite budget version basis is the model policy snapshot plus external route identity/kind/dispatch/pricing/metering. Query/query_id/search-policy file SHA and lease epoch are absent.

create_company_scan_task never reads lifecycle external retrieval or search-policy file; native group key includes entity/name/scope/perimeter and excludes lease token/epoch. Unchanged original owner/task inputs and generation therefore permit unchanged registered task SHA.
required_runtime_assertions: Bind audit cost_source_ref to failed-cold-pretransport-resolved-review.json exact SHA, not invented provider evidence.
Do not delete or update old immutable search operation/dispatch/result/unknown receipt; retain original budget ledger and policy_id/version.
Wait for real wall time >= original lease_expires_at; re-read status, generation and model attempts before recover_expired.
If any native send intent/response/uncertain attempt appears, stop; do not force pending or use this plan.
After original public recover_expired returns pending, let original engine generation_scope/owner_batch_claim perform the only new claim; do not manually populate private handles.
Recompute retry composite and assert exact equality to original confirmed budget; assert original registered task SHA and owner inputs unchanged.
Preserve old source pins/cold session/history; new retry session and immutable retry pin list must separately bind fixed wrapper and query-policy revision.
No claim of cached model recovery before a new actual model response exists; subsequent cold/recover acceptance must examine original same-ledger rows and no-new-HTTP evidence.
limitations: This is source-level review of the recorded retry plan, not evidence that runtime retry assertions have passed.
A query-id change without explicit original confirmed_not_sent reconciliation would remain unresolved and is not approved by this review.
